category_description: Public pensions and retirement benefits in Canada.
subcategory_description: The Old Age Security pension and the income-tested benefits that go with it.
label: Maximum monthly OAS pension, ages 65 to 74
context: Maximum for a full pension. Amounts are reviewed each January, April, July and October for cost of living and do not fall.

label: Maximum monthly OAS pension, age 75 and over
context: Includes the 10% increase for people aged 75 and over. Maximum for a full pension. Amounts are reviewed each January, April, July and October for cost of living and do not fall.

label: Net world income limit for OAS, ages 65 to 74 (2025 income)
context: A person whose annual net world income is at or above this amount gets no OAS pension.

label: Net world income limit for OAS, age 75 and over (2025 income)
context: A person whose annual net world income is at or above this amount gets no OAS pension.

label: OAS recovery tax threshold
context: Net income above this amount can mean part or all of the OAS pension has to be repaid.

label: Increase in OAS for each month the start is delayed after age 65
context: Up to a total of 36% at age 70.

subject_intro: Who can get an Old Age Security pension, the maximum monthly amounts, the income limits and recovery tax, and how delaying the start raises the payment.
subject_meta_title: OAS Canada: Up to {fact:ca_oas_max_65} a Month
subject_meta_description: The OAS pension pays up to {fact:ca_oas_max_65} a month at 65 to 74 and {fact:ca_oas_max_75} from 75. See who qualifies, the income limits and how delaying changes it.
